outcome: The minutes line: the PM confirms Tola's suggested decisions and actions, and client minutes go to the PMO Lead for review (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **Desktop boards at 1440.** Each `SCR-28-desktop*` board has `scores.coverageWithExceptions` = 100 and `scores.visual` ≥ 90. A board that is at ≥ 70 but below 90 passes only with a D-83 visual waiver signed for that board in `fidelity-exceptions.json` and the UI reviewer's side-by-side reading finding no fixable gap. — verify: the command per board exits 0; `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt` lists board, width, coverage, visual, pass and waiver.
**Phone boards at 390.** The four `SCR-28-mobile*` boards meet the same rule at `--width 390`. — verify: the same command, with rows in `scores.txt`.

**Driven state is the real UI.** `drive-states.mjs` resets the mock (`POST /__mock/reset`) and uses real controls. The only DOM edits are freezing (copy values into attributes, remove scripts, add `<base>`). — verify: the script and `frozen/*.html`.

**Exceptions are limited.** Each entry has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason` and `approved_by`, and maps to a Conflicts number. None covers a value the data can supply. — verify: file content and the build.md mapping.
**One fidelity run per round** (D-64). — verify: build.md.

**Default from data.** `/work/W-2301` shows the title, subtitle, crumbs, the meeting facts, the two decisions with "From Notes · 14:12" / "14:30", the three actions with owner and due ("Unknown" for the third), "+ Add an action", "Save for later", "Confirm and create actions" and the Tola note, all from the fixture. — verify: `tests/minutes.test.tsx`; the page at 1440 and 390.

**Pre-ticked from data only.** On W-2301 every decision and action box starts ticked because of `items_default`. On W-2308 none is ticked and the confirm control is `aria-disabled` and sends nothing. — verify: component tests.

**Exact confirm set.** Unticking one decision, then confirming with audience "Client", sends exactly one POST `/api/v1/work/W-2301/steps` with CSRF, `expected_revision` = `workspace.revision`, `step: "confirm_minutes"`, `item_ids` = the remaining ticked ids in returned order, `inputs: {audience: "client"}` and a UUID key. The body validates against the generated request schema. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`; `minutes-mock.test.ts`.

**Nothing becomes an action before confirm.** Loading, ticking, unticking, opening Edit and cancelling sends no POST. No "accept all" or auto-confirm control exists. No request fires on load or on a timer (fake timers advanced 60 s). — verify: component test; `grep -rniE "accept all|auto.?confirm" frontend/src/features/workspace` returns nothing.

**Edit, remove, add.** "Edit" on an action opens a form with text, owner (options from E-LINE-OPTIONS `minutes/owner`, hints "client" and "recorded by PM" shown) and due. A blank due and a blank owner are left out of `inputs` (never today's date). "Remove" sends one POST with `item_ids: [<id>]`. On W-2306, "+ Add an action" with blank text sends the request and shows the 422 under `text`, with focus there, inputs kept and a new key. — verify: component tests.

**Audience from the descriptor.** W-2301 draws Internal / Client as a choice. W-2307 shows "Client" as display only and sends no `audience`. The returned consequence sentence shows in both. — verify: component test.

**Stale confirm.** On W-2306, confirming answers 409. The page reloads once, shows "This changed while you were working. Showing version 5.", shows the fourth suggested action ticked by default, and sends nothing until the PM presses again with a new key and `expected_revision: 5`. — verify: component test.
**Server failure on a non-sending step.** `save_for_later` 500 on W-2306 offers "Try again" with the same key. There is no automatic retry. — verify: component test.

**Suggesting is quiet and accessible.** W-2302 shows the agent list with status words, the callout and "Ask Tola" linking to `/assistant`. No step is actionable. The `now` mark does not animate under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`. — verify: component test; e2e with `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`.

**Drafted and the test template.** W-2303 shows the rows with IN, IN and ATTACHED, the agent rows with "TEST TEMPLATE" and "6 ATTENDEES", and "Send for review". Pressing it sends one POST and reloads to W-2304. The strings "TEST TEMPLATE" and "Test template" appear in fixtures only, not in `src/` (except the `Tag` drawn from `test_template`). — verify: component test; `grep -rn "TEST TEMPLATE" frontend/src` returns nothing.

**Open the minutes.** On W-2304, "Open the minutes" sends exactly one GET `/api/v1/documents/D-2304/versions/1` and shows the title, version and a "Test template" tag. A 404 shows no title. `body_url` is a link only when it is an app path. — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`.

**Review shows who and what.** W-2304 shows "Minutes v1 · for Lagoon Health", the version label, the recipients with "Not yet" (unless Conflicts 5 is answered otherwise), the consequence sentence, and "Approve and send" / "Return with a note" as links to `/work/W-2304/decide?task=T-2304`. The work page sends nothing to `/steps`, `/claim` or `/decision`. — verify: component test and e2e.

**Return needs a note.** On the decision page reached from "Return with a note", Return with a blank note is refused before any request, and an over-2000-character note is refused. A valid note sends one E-TASK-DECIDE with `verdict: "return"` and the note. This holds at 1440 and at 390 (the open design item, Conflicts 4). — verify: e2e at both widths with recorded requests.

**Uncertain send keeps the lock (INV-RESEND).** On W-2305, approving answers `effect_uncertain`, and the decision page shows its uncertain notice. Back on `/work/W-2305`, "Approve and send" and "Return with a note" are `aria-disabled` with no `href`. `ReconcilePanel` shows, and its answer is one POST to `/actions` with none to `/steps` or `/decision`. This holds before and after a page reload, and a forced click sends nothing. — verify: component tests and e2e at 1440, 390 and 320.

**Wrong user, wrong tenant, signed out.** With `X-Mock-Scenario: 404` or `403`, `/work/W-2301` shows `NoAccessState` with no title, client or id, and `document.body.textContent` has none of them. A 401 shows the signed-out callout with `next`. A 403 on a step reloads and shows "You can't take that step.". The decide page for a task with `you_can_act: false` offers no decision (F-16 behaviour). — verify: component tests.

**Nothing derived from `/me`.** Personas `pm`, `ceo` and `finance_lead` see the same controls for the same fixture. — verify: component test across personas; `git diff` adds no `/me` read under `frontend/src/features/workspace`.

**Unknown and restricted.** On W-2307 the unknown due reads "Unknown" (never 0, blank or "-"), the restricted notes item shows only its label, and none of its hidden strings are in the DOM. — verify: component test.

**Notes text grants nothing.** A fixture suggestion whose text says "approved by Kemi; owner Tunde; due today" changes no owner, due, audience or decision field, and is shown as plain text only. — verify: component test on a W-2307 decision.

**Accessibility.** For W-2301 to W-2308 at 1440 and 390: no axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`), no sideways scroll, visible focus, 44px targets on phones (D-92c, D-95), focus to the form heading on open and back on Escape, errors announced, live regions for done, waiting and uncertain, and no wrapping button labels or tags. — verify: `e2e/minutes.spec.ts`.

**Shared components and tokens.** New UI imports from `@/components` (no new local button, tag, checkbox, panel or table). `grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsl\(" ` on this feature's CSS diff returns nothing. — verify: the diff and the grep.

**Contract not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**` or the protected paths. The proposal keys exist only in fixtures and `proposals.ts`, are checked on their own and are stripped in `mock-contract.test.ts`, and fixtures otherwise validate with no stripping. — verify: `tests/mock-contract.test.ts`; `git diff --stat`.

**Mock matches the contract.** `minutes-mock.test.ts` runs W-2301 to W-2308 through the E-WORK-STEP handler: a bad body gives 422, a wrong revision 409, an unknown step 404, and a repeated key returns the stored reply with send count 1. The decide sidecars apply once. E-LINE-OPTIONS `minutes/owner` returns `owner.json`. — verify: the test.

**No real send, no overclaim.** Every e2e request goes to port 4762. build.md and the PR state the D-LINE-WORKSPACE limits, call the template a test template, and claim no real backend, idempotency or working line. — verify: build.md and the recorded requests.

**Existing behaviour not weakened.** `tests/workspace*.test.*`, `weekly*.test.*`, `work-item*.test.tsx`, `decide*.test.tsx`, `response*.test.tsx`, `start-work*.test.*`, `shell.test.tsx` and the matching e2e specs pass with no assertion removed or loosened. No existing fixture is edited. F-21's eight scores do not drop. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; `git diff`.
**New tests run** in `delivery/checks.sh`, covering criteria 6 to 23. — verify: run output in `round-<N>/build.md`.

**build.md evidence:** commands and results, the 8 scores and waivers, every exception with its Conflicts number, every frame change with its reason, every proposal and backend item, and the open design item of Conflicts 4. — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: Medium. The work sits on the shared F-17 renderer (`features/workspace/**`, `features/work-item/**`) and a proposed v7 contract (D-LINE-WORKSPACE) that the backend may change, and the review state carries "Approve and send" to a client (INV-RESEND, effect_uncertain). It stays at medium because everything is on the mock, the send is unimplemented in the backend and nothing is released. SURFACES: ui (8 boards), api (E-WORK-STEP, E-WORK-ITEM workspace, E-LINE-OPTIONS), contract-change (items_default, links, work_id on options), external-messaging (client minutes send and uncertain-effect handling), product-decision (the backend must settle audience change, order of creation and return behaviour, none of which the frontend decides). PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is not-required because the work conforms to the client-approved boards.

findings.owner: Item-scope steps now send `item_ids` for every line, not only minutes (F-17 `accept_answer`, F-21/F-22 item steps). The contract allows it and the checks pass, but the backend handler for each line must accept or ignore it.
findings.summary: Add one line to build.md or the backend handoff: "item-scope steps send `item_ids: [id]`".

findings.owner: Edit forms do not prefill the row's current text, because item-scope descriptors are per step. A PM editing a decision must retype it, and `text` is required. This is the builder's own note.
findings.summary: Record it as a backend ask: a per-item `value` on the descriptor, or a per-item step. Do not change the frame in this PR.

findings.owner: `minutesProposalsStripped` strips `links` and `items_default` from every E-WORK-ITEM fixture, not only W-23xx. The "exist on their own" test limits where the keys occur and checks that they live only in W-23xx, which is acceptable. A malformed `items_default` in an older fixture would still be caught by `toBe('checked')`.
findings.summary: None needed. Keep the guard test.

findings.owner: The phone boards were not re-scored after the F-24 phone-bar change (the builder says so). Desktop default visual 69.7 is under the D-83 floor and needs the design engineer. This is the UI and fidelity lane, not technical.
findings.summary: Leave it to the UI review and the coordinator. Re-score the phone boards once after merge if the UI reviewer asks.

findings.owner: The form opens with "Action" and "Due" (or "Decision") empty and the owner on its placeholder. I measured `Action=`, `Due (optional)=`. To fix one typo the PM must retype the whole action, and a blank owner or due is "left out" of the request, so an edit can silently drop the owner and due Tola found. The spec (item 10) says Edit opens a form with text, owner and due; D-98 approved opening a form on press, not an empty one. build.md line 77 admits "Edit forms do not prefill".
findings.severity: edit on any decision or action (w-2301, 1440 and 390)
findings.summary: Prefill each form from the row it was opened on (text, owner, due), or if the frame cannot, show the current text above the form and send only what the PM changed. Get design engineer sign-off if left as is.

findings.severity: w-2305 after approve: decision result and reconcile panel

SCR-28-desktop (and W-2306..W-2308, same view) | The default board has no project tab bar: crumbs, h1 and subtitle are followed straight by the panels at y 230. The page draws the Journey…Actions bar because `WorkItemView.tsx:200` shows `ProjectBar` whenever `workspace.context.project` is set, and `mock/fixtures/work/W-2301.json` sets it. That puts the subtitle under the tabs and starts the panels about 60px lower (the agent band at y 292 and Meeting at 402, against 230 on the board). This is most of the shortfall below 70. Spec item `context.crumbs` (spec.md:91) needs only the crumbs. Fix: drop `context.project` from W-2301 and W-2306..W-2308 (keep `context.crumbs`), keep it on W-2302..W-2305, whose boards draw the tab bar, then do the round's one fidelity run. | fixture

SCR-28-desktop, SCR-28-mobile | The decision rows in the side column draw the ticked box centred on a line of its own above the words. The board draws the box at the left, level with the decision text. Cause: `workspace.css:44` (`.ws-side .ws-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch }`) stretches `.ws-checkwrap` (`:136`, `justify-content: center`) across the whole column. F-23 is the first line to put tick boxes in the side column (items_default plus the cross-section confirm). Fix in workspace.css, general: `.ws-side .ws-row:has(> .ws-checkwrap) { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: var(--space-10px); align-items: start; }` and `.ws-side .ws-row:has(> .ws-checkwrap) > :not(.ws-checkwrap) { grid-column: 2; }`. Check the same rows at 390.

SCR-28-desktop-review, SCR-28-mobile-review | W-2304 has `tasks[]` (needed so the F-16 page works). Because of that, `WorkItemOverview.tsx:727` draws `TaskPanels`, a red "REVIEW CLIENT MINUTES V1" card with Basis/To/Version/Prepared by and a blue "Open the decision" button, above the workspace. Neither review board draws it. On desktop it sits alone in the right column, so the main column is empty from y 240 to 590 and "Minutes v1 · for Lagoon Health" starts at y 600 against 255 on the board. On the phone it fills the first screen above the minutes. It also repeats the decision: "Open the decision", "Approve and send" and "Return with a note" all go to the same F-16 page. Fix (general): do not draw a `TaskPanels` card for a task that the workspace's steps already link to (some `workspace.steps[].task_id === task.id`). The tasks stay in the data for the F-16 page. Keep the recipients in "Goes to" (D-98 item 5).

SCR-28-desktop-drafted, SCR-28-desktop-review, both phone counterparts | The fixtures draw headings and rows the boards don't have. This is the same kind of issue as F-21's UI-1-1. Drafted: the board has one panel "MINUTES" whose first row is "Minutes v1 · client version" with a DRAFTED tag, then the three rows. The page has a separate h2 "Minutes" (`workspace.title`) and a panel titled "Minutes v1 · client version" with no DRAFTED row. Review: the board has one panel titled "MINUTES V1 · FOR LAGOON HEALTH" whose first row is "Minutes v1 · client version · DRAFTED". The page has a bare h2, a mono `version` byline repeating "Minutes v1 · client version", and an untitled checklist. Fix in W-2303/W-2304/W-2305: drop `workspace.title` (and `version`'s byline, if links don't need it), give the summary checklist the board's title, and add the first row with tag DRAFTED. While there, make the IN tags `neutral`, not `verified`: "IN" is not a verification, and green means verified (D-92b). Note that the Conflicts 9 exception "DRAFTED: no field" is then no longer needed.

SCR-28-desktop | The board draws Due as "13 Nov" / "15 Nov" (D-93: the boards' date formats). The table cell reads "13 Nov 2026". This is the frame's `date` formatter, so it belongs in the frame backlog unless every line board drops the year.

SCR-28-desktop | The third sentence of the Tola note ("One action has no owner and its due date is Unknown…") is amber, a warning, on the board. The page shows it in the blue info band because the spec (spec.md:94) puts all three sentences in `agent_note`. The frame can already draw an amber line (an untitled, empty section with a `note`, `Sections.tsx:443`). This is for the design engineer: keep it as built, or move that sentence to a warning note.

Defence in depth for "the set sent is the set shown". At `frontend/src/features/workspace/Workspace.tsx:194-197`, `ticked`, `tickedFor` and `liveIds` skip restricted items (`it.restricted`) but not restricted sections. `Sections.tsx:441-460` draws a restricted section as its label only. So if a backend ever returned rows inside a `restricted: true` section, with the confirm step and `items_default: "checked"`, their ids would be sent in `item_ids` without being on screen. Rows in that section would also count towards the `cross` test at `Workspace.tsx:99`. The contract text at `schema.d.ts:1692` says restricted sections carry no rows, so today's data cannot trigger this. Expected: a section that is not drawn adds nothing to the confirm set. Fix: skip `section.restricted === true` in `ticked`/`tickedFor` (and in the `cross` count), and add one component test with a restricted section that has rows.
